jobs.title: VP, M&A & Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Description
FIS Management Services, LLC seeks VP, M&A & Transformation in Jacksonville, FL to run and manage Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) processes covering acquisitions, material minority investments and divestitures, including strategic rationale, project management, due diligence phase, negotiations with vendor and bidder, and managing third party advisors. Engage in the market on behalf of FIS to build understanding of current M&A processes and longer-term market trends and themes. Communicate FIS strategies and priorities where appropriate. Form relationships with investment banks, private equity funds, management consultants, FIS partners and customers. Develop close relationships with senior FIS business executives to identify how M&A could support their business agenda, such as identifying acquisition and divestiture opportunities. Manage financial modelling to support M&A strategy and perform evaluations of specific opportunities. Support FIS venture investments team, support to shape overall corporate strategy, working closely with FIS executive team, lines of business and functional areas. Prepare corporate strategy, M&A and venture investing materials to support board of directors’ meetings.

REQUIREMENTS : Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or related field and six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in the job offered or a related occupation: utilizing financial modelling and valuation analysis to support M&A transactions including acquisitions, mergers and sales of companies; implementing due diligence management for M&A transactions; negotiating M&A transactions; structuring M&A transactions including equity vs. debt structures, and equity purchase vs. asset purchase; strategizing and advising on M&A transactions including pipeline management, strategy development, target evaluation, and divestiture and sale assessments. Telecommuting and/or working from home may be permissible pursuant to company policies. In the alternative, the employer will accept a Master’s degree in the above listed fields and four (4) years of experience in the above listed skills.

jobs.title: Senior Change Management Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all fun.

About the team:
PRIME Processing Change Management is the team responsible for evaluating client requirements, assessing business and technical needs, and providing guidance on the most appropriate delivery approach. The team works closely with stakeholders to determine whether requested enhancements can be achieved through existing system configuration or require application development and change. In doing so, they help ensure solutions are aligned with business objectives, operational efficiency, and platform capabilities.

What you will be doing:
As a Senior Change Management Consultant, you will manage assigned technical accounts, ensuring client satisfaction and alignment with service delivery standards. You will act as a trusted advisor and technical expert, helping clients clarify their business needs, understand system functionality and progress their technical priorities.

The key responsibilities of the role will be:
- Act as the primary technical contact for assigned clients, working closely with the Relationship Manager and internal teams.

- Develop and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and technical expert.

- Engage with clients to understand their strategic goals, business needs and technical requirements, including preliminary requirements gathering before formal project initiation.

- Use a strong understanding of system functionality, product capabilities and payment processing to help shape client pipeline, roadmap and solution discussions.

- Coordinate with delivery, product, sales and other internal teams to address client requirements and advocate for product improvements aligned to client needs.

- Support account growth opportunities through technical expertise.

What you bring:
- Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business, Computer Science or a related area, or equivalent experience.

- Minimum 5 years’ relevant experience in technical account management, client-facing technology, payments, software, or IT environments.

- Strong understanding of business requirements, gathering and ability to translate client needs into clear technical requirements.

- Ability to understand system functionality and explain product capabilities, constraints and solution options to clients and internal stakeholders.

- Excellent relationship management, communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and collaborative approach.

- Strong analytical skills, sound judgement, and the ability to manage priorities with limited supervision.

Added bonus if you have:
- Experience in the payment systems industry or payment processing environment.

- Account management experience supporting regional or international clients.

- Experience working with delivery, product, sales, or software development teams.

What we offer you:

- Private medical insurance for you and your family, non-contributory, in and out patient cover

- Flexible working (hybrid model – part from home, part from office)

jobs.title: VP, Head of Program Management & Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
Job Description
Vice President, Head of Program Management & Strategic Initiatives

About FIS
FIS is a leading provider of technology solutions for financial institutions and businesses of all sizes and across all industries — in the world. We empower the financial world by enabling the movement of money, processing trillions of dollars annually, and powering thousands of banks, capital markets firms, and merchants globally. Our Technology organization is the engine behind that mission, building the platforms, infrastructure, and digital experiences that move the global economy forward.

Position Summary
The Vice President, Head of Program Management & Strategic Initiatives is a senior executive within the FIS Technology organization, accountable for leading the enterprise Technology Program Management Office (TPMO) and driving the most consequential, cross-functional initiatives across the technology portfolio. This leader serves as a trusted advisor to the CTO/CIO and the broader Technology Leadership Team, translating strategy into executable, measurable programs and ensuring disciplined delivery of FIS's most complex modernization, integration, and transformation efforts.
The role combines strategic vision with operational rigor. The successful leader will shape how Technology plans, prioritizes, governs, and executes work at scale — orchestrating multi-year transformation programs, platform consolidations, cloud and AI initiatives, and enterprise-level operating model changes. This leader will build and lead a high-performing organization of program directors, program managers, and PMO professionals supporting Technology globally.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership
- Partner with the CTO/CIO and Technology Leadership Team to translate enterprise strategy into a coherent portfolio of programs, investments, and outcomes.
- Lead the design and execution of high-priority, cross-functional strategic initiatives — such as platform modernization, cloud migration, AI/ML enablement, technology rationalization & productivity transformation.

Program Management
- Establish and continuously evolve the Technology PMO operating model, methodologies, and tooling — balancing Agile, hybrid, and waterfall approaches based on program need.
- Drive rigor in scope, schedule, budget, risk, and dependency management across the portfolio; ensure programs deliver business outcomes — not just outputs.
- Define and maintain enterprise standards for program planning, status reporting, escalation, OKRs, and KPIs.
- Lead executive-level program reviews; provide clear, data-driven visibility to the CTO/CIO, CEO staff, Board, and other senior stakeholders.

Execution & Delivery
- Personally lead or sponsor the most complex, highest-risk, and highest-visibility programs across Technology.
- Identify and remove organizational, technical, and resourcing blockers; drive accountability across program leaders and partner functions.
- Establish disciplined change management practices to ensure adoption and value capture for major transformation efforts.
- Partner closely with Finance to manage Technology investment portfolios — capital plans, operating budgets, vendor spend, and ROI tracking.

Organizational Leadership
- Build, lead, mentor, and develop a globally distributed team of program directors, program managers, PMO analysts, and transformation professionals.
- Cultivate a culture of ownership, transparency, intellectual honesty, and outcome-orientation.
- Recruit and retain top program leadership talent; create career paths and development frameworks for the program management discipline at FIS.
- Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring, development, and leadership practices.

Stakeholder & Executive Engagement
- Represent the Technology organization in executive forums, steering committees, and board-level reporting on strategic programs.

Required Qualifications
- 15+ years of progressive experience in program management, technology delivery, management consulting, or transformation leadership, including 5+ years leading large, multi-tier program management organizations.
- Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale transformation programs (>$50M, multi-year, multi-region) within complex, matrixed organizations.
- Deep experience in financial services, fintech, payments, or a similarly regulated technology environment.
- Proven ability to operate at the executive level — directly advising C-suite leaders, presenting to boards, and influencing across functional boundaries.
- Strong command of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, SAFe, Lean, hybrid) and portfolio management practices and tooling (e.g., Jira Align, Clarity, Planview, ServiceNow SPM).
- Experience leading or supporting M&A technology integration, divestitures, or carve-outs.
- Track record of building and scaling teams of 50+ across geographies.
- Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills; able to distill complexity into clear narratives and decisions.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications
- MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
- PMP, PgMP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), or equivalent professional certifications.
- Direct experience with cloud transformation (AWS, Azure, GCP), platform modernization, data/AI programs, or core banking/payments platform migrations.
- Prior experience in a global, publicly traded technology or financial services company.
- Background in management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, Accenture) combined with operating experience.

Leadership Competencies
- Strategic Thinking — Connects technology execution to business outcomes and long-term competitive positioning.
- Executive Influence — Builds credibility quickly across senior stakeholders; communicates with clarity and conviction.
- Bias for Outcomes — Drives delivery and benefits realization, not just activity.
- Operational Rigor — Brings structure, discipline, and data to ambiguous, high-stakes problems.
- Talent Multiplier — Develops leaders, attracts top talent, and builds organizations that outperform.
- Integrity & Judgment — Demonstrates the highest standards of ethics, transparency, and decision-making.

What We Offer
- Competitive executive compensation including base salary, annual incentive, and long-term equity.
- Comprehensive health, retirement (401k with match), and wellness benefits.
- Generous paid time off and a hybrid working model.
- The opportunity to shape the technology agenda of one of the world's most consequential fintech companies.
- A culture that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.

Location: Germany or Zurich, Switzerland (Hybrid)

About FIS
At FIS, we power the world's economy through innovative financial technology solutions. We help businesses, banks, and capital markets participants solve complex challenges and drive growth through technology. Join a global fintech leader and help transform the future of treasury and financial management solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Account Manager – Treasury Solutions to join our growing sales organisation focused on the DACH region. In this role, you will support the expansion of our Treasury Management System (TMS) business by developing new opportunities within mid-market corporate clients across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
This position is ideal for a sales professional with experience in B2B SaaS or financial technology who is looking to build expertise in treasury transformation solutions while working alongside experienced enterprise sales leaders.

About the Team
You will be part of a high-performing European sales team dedicated to delivering treasury and risk management solutions to corporate organisations. The team works closely with pre-sales consultants, product specialists, marketing, and implementation teams to ensure customers receive tailored solutions and a seamless buying experience throughout the sales lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the identification, development, and conversion of new business opportunities across mid-market corporates within the DACH region.
- Manage key stages of the sales process from prospecting and qualification through to negotiation and deal closure.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Directors, and other senior finance stakeholders.
- Position and articulate the value of FIS Treasury Management System (TMS) solutions to address client challenges and business objectives.
- Collaborate with senior sales executives and cross-functional teams to progress opportunities and achieve revenue objectives.
- Maintain accurate pipeline tracking, forecasting, and opportunity management within CRM systems.
- Stay informed on treasury, cash management, and financial technology market trends, as well as competitor activities and treasury transformation initiatives.
- Contribute to a collaborative and high-performance sales culture across the region.

Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have Requirements
- Proven experience in B2B SaaS sales to corporate clients.
- Demonstrated track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
- Experience selling or supporting financial technology, treasury, banking, or related software solutions.
- Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred Experience
- Experience selling or supporting Treasury Management Systems (TMS) .
- Understanding of treasury operations, cash management, liquidity management, or treasury workflows.
- Experience working with mid-market corporate organisations across the DACH region.

About the Role
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic  Senior Lead, Technology Strategy Analyst  to help shape and support key business and technology strategy initiatives. This role will partner closely with senior executives and cross-functional leaders to drive strategic planning, market intelligence, business analysis, and executive communications.

The ideal candidate combines strong strategic thinking with exceptional research and storytelling capabilities. They are skilled at translating complex information into actionable insights and executive-level presentations that influence decision-making. This highly-visible role requires a strong understanding of industry trends, competitive dynamics, strategic frameworks, and business performance drivers.

What you will be doing:
This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping strategic priorities and helping leadership make informed decisions that drive long-term business success. You will have direct exposure to senior executives, contribute to high-impact initiatives, and influence the future direction of the organization. If you thrive at the intersection of strategy, research, analysis, and executive storytelling, this role offers a unique platform to make a measurable impact.

Key Success Factors
- Deliver strategic insights that influence executive decisions.

- Produce best-in-class executive and board-level presentations.

- Identify market trends and competitive intelligence that shape strategy.

- Enable data-driven planning and prioritization across the organization.

Strategic Planning & Business Analysis
- Support the development of enterprise, business unit and technology strategies.

- Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify growth opportunities, operational improvements, strategic priorities and narratives.

- Develop strategic narratives and executive decision-support materials.

- Assist in annual, multi-year, and long-range strategic planning processes.

Market & Competitive Intelligence
- Conduct comprehensive market research to identify industry trends, emerging growth, and competitive developments.

- Analyze industry standards, benchmarks, and best practices to inform strategic recommendations.

- Synthesize external research into actionable insights for senior leadership.

Executive Communications & Storytelling
- Create executive-ready presentations, strategic narratives, and briefing documents.

- Translate complex analyses into concise, compelling business stories.

- Develop high-quality PowerPoint presentations that clearly communicate strategic priorities, risks, opportunities, and outcomes.

- Partner with senior stakeholders to prepare presentations for leadership, board, and client audiences.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner with business, finance, operations, product, technology, and transformation teams to gather insights and align strategic priorities.

- Facilitate working sessions, strategy workshops, and planning discussions.

- Build relationships across the organization to support enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.

Who You Are
- A strategic thinker who can connect market insights, business objectives, and operational realities into actionable recommendations.

- Naturally curious and passionate about understanding industries, competitors, and future trends.

- An exceptional communicator who can simplify complexity and influence stakeholders through clear storytelling.

- Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, quality, and executive-level polish.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Highly collaborative and capable of building credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

- Self-motivated, proactive, and driven to continuously improve how strategy is developed and communicated.

What you will need:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Strategy, Technology, or a related field.

- 6-10+ years of experience in strategy, management consulting, corporate planning, business analysis, technology strategy, or a related field.

- Demonstrated experience supporting strategic planning initiatives and executive decision-making processes.

- Strong experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and industry benchmarking.

- Experience developing executive-level presentations and strategic communications for senior leadership.

- Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

- Strong proficiency in strategic frameworks, business intelligence, and market analysis techniques.

- Expertise in gathering, synthesizing, and interpreting large amounts of information from multiple sources.

- Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint skills with the ability to create polished, executive-ready presentations.

- Strong Microsoft Excel capabilities for financial, operational, and strategic analyses.

- Ability to transform complex data into compelling visual stories and strategic insights.

Added bonus if you have:
- Experience supporting executive leadership teams, boards of directors, or C-suite stakeholders.

- Background in technology, financial services, consulting, or large-scale enterprise environments.
- Experience evaluating emerging industry trends, AI technologies, digital transformation, and competitive market dynamics.

Job Description
At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays,   banks   and   invests . We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues,   clients   and communities succeed. If   you’re   ready to grow your career and make an impact   in   fintech, we have one question: Are you FIS?

About the role:

FIS is looking for a Revenue Operations Lead role to help further accelerate our growth by helping to improve our sales performance and efficiency.   You’ll   ensure we have best-in-class ,   sales strategy   processes, tools, and analytical horsepower   to fuel our broader go-to-market (GTM) function. This is a pivotal role that directly contributes to the success of our GTM teams.

We’re   looking for someone who is eager to build a new standard for   RevOps   within one of the largest Fintech businesses in the world. We are looking for a   self- starter,   who   can handle ambiguity   and   thrives in environments with multiple cross-functional stakeholders with varying priorities. You can more than hold your own with the day-to-day requests, but your real passion is digging deep, finding out the “why,” and providing insights to the   Commercial   Organization to make better decisions.

As part of the Revenue Operations team,   you’ll   get the chance to shape the function and have lots of autonomy and impact. You will report to our   Senior Director of Revenue Operations   and be one of their main operational partners supporting the successful development and execution of our strategy.

What you will be doing:

Revenue Operations-

- Craft and   optimize   customer segmentation and sales strategy to ensure coverage model enables focus on target segments

- Produce, share, and present   field coverage reports analyzing penetration, number of accounts per territory, number of accounts per sales executive in each territory, type,   size   and potential of accounts, etc.

- Extract insights (e.g., characteristics of territories that perform well, differences between territories that perform well and those that underperform) from data and produced reports to provide a data-driven explanation of performance at the territory level and ensures changes are properly reflected in all Sales Reporting Tools and updated in the internal sales territory maps

- Manage field-related inquiries   regarding   performance to plan, account assignments and sales plan

- Partner with senior sales leaders to uncover opportunities for growth or sales force efficiency improvement

Strategy & Analytics-

- Build and   maintain   the analytical models that underpin revenue strategy, including customer segmentation, territory design, quota setting and sales capacity planning

- Translate pipeline,   bookings   and win/loss data into insights that shape go-to-market priorities and guide where the Commercial Organization invests

- Develop scenario and growth models that quantify the revenue impact of strategic choices, and present clear recommendations to senior sales and Revenue Operations leadership

- Design and evolve the reporting and dashboard layer so sales leaders can self-serve the metrics that matter, with a single trusted source for revenue performance data

- Partner with Finance, Product and Sales leadership on annual planning, turning strategic   objectives   into measurable operating targets and tracking progress against them

Special Projects Leadership-

- Identify , lead, and manage strategic projects,   leveraging   your problem-solving skills to drive process improvements and revenue enhancement initiatives.

- Take the initiative in coordinating resources from multiple departments to   optimize   processes and support overarching business goals.

- Gather, develop, and analyze information   from multiple teams and develop efficient processes and reports to support the business

What you will need:

- Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM field or Economics

- 2-7 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, venture capital, corporate strategy, revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations in a technology/financial services company

- Very strong   analytical background

- Outstanding program management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

- Ambiguous problem-solving and executive communication skills, with ability to   facilitate   meetings with executives and partner across multiple functions in an organization

- Positive, can-do, roll up the sleeves and get things done mindset

​

Added bonus   if you have:

- MBA or   Master's   degree in a technical or quantitative field.

- Proficiency   in Tableau, Power BI, SQL

- Proficiency   in sales tools such as MS Dynamics,   SalesForce , Outreach, and Gong

- Experience with   AI tools

​

What we offer you:
At FIS, we   are as   committed to growing our employees’ careers as our own business. We offer:

- Opportunities to innovate in fintech

- Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere

- Professional and personal development

- Resources to contribute to your community

Job Description
Every day at FIS, innovators, problem solvers and changemakers work together to create technology that advances the world of finance. We embrace new ideas, challenge what's possible and empower our teams to make a lasting impact. If you're ready to help shape the future of fintech, unlock your next chapter with FIS.

About the role
As a Sr Lead FP&A Analyst, you will lead financial planning, forecasting, reporting and performance analysis for the Chief Technology Office. You will partner with technology and finance leaders to translate financial results into clear business insights, coordinate planning targets and support investment decisions. This role also helps improve the technology organization's financial operating model through automation, cost-saving initiatives and stronger planning processes.

Your key responsibilities
· Lead long-range planning, annual budgeting, forecasting and close reporting for the Chief Technology Office.
· Deliver monthly financial reporting and variance analysis across plan, forecast and actual results for key stakeholders.
· Partner with technology leaders to develop, communicate and secure approval for budgets, forecasts and planning targets.
· Guide the financial evaluation, sizing, approval and execution of automation, cost-saving and investment initiatives.
· Improve financial processes, reporting and decision support to help build a best-in-class technology business and financial model.

What you bring
Required qualifications
· Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field.
· Five or more years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting or a related finance role, including support for annual budgets, monthly forecasts and long-range plans.
· Strong financial modeling, forecasting, variance analysis and scenario-planning skills, along with a solid understanding of accounting concepts.
· Advanced Microsoft Excel skills,
including complex formulas, pivot tables and financial models.
· Proven ability to translate complex financial information into clear recommendations, communicate with senior leaders and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred qualifications
· Master of Business Administration, Certified Public Accountant, Chartered Financial Analyst or a similar advanced credential.
· Experience with financial planning systems such as Hyperion, Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning, SAP or Oracle.
· Experience partnering with technology, product, operations or other non-finance teams and improving financial planning and reporting processes.

The impact you'll make
In this role, you will strengthen how the Chief Technology Office plans, measures and communicates financial performance. Your work will help leaders understand tradeoffs, direct investments and identify opportunities to operate more efficiently. By connecting financial discipline with technology priorities, you will support better decisions and a more scalable operating model.

jobs.description:
About the Role
This role forms part of the Commercial Finance team, covering the whole of FIS. Commercial Finance supports the Commercial organization under Nasser Khodri with clear guidance on deal structuring, revenue recognition considerations to maximise revenue, cash flow and protection of recurring revenue through proactive deal oversight. Together with Sales Finance we also provide insights and deal intelligence into the forecasting process to better forecast sales to revenue conversion. We collaborate with product Finance and Accounting to ensure accuracy of forecasts and accounting records.

What you will be doing
As the Finance Analyst Lead, Deal Hub, you will partner with FIS’ Capital Markets division providing deal support to Sales and Commercial Pricing teams with deal analysis, revenue recognition and policy guidance, and working with legal teams through contract negotiations to ensure pricing, margins, and financial viability of commercial activities are achieved and reflected in contracts.
- Act as a finance partner through commercial aspects of client engagements to ensure deals are structured in a financially viable and repeatable manner on pricing, margins, deal structure and revenue recognition treatment for multi-faceted software license and services contracts.
- Work closely with the commercial teams, lines of business, regional sales teams, Segment and Line of Business finance leads, legal department, and Revenue Assurance to achieve optimal outcomes for FIS.
- Ensure the appropriate revenue recognition for all revenue arrangements under US GAAP and company policy, escalate revenue recognition issues accordingly to Head of Regional Deal Hub and Corporate Revenue Assurance.
- Proactively seek out and profile non-standard deals in the pipeline, coordinate reviews with stakeholders in the Groups and drive value through pricing and contract structuring.
- Highlight complex, material bids that require Deal Review Committee approval and coordinate preparation of material with sales to ensure deal review meetings are well planned and effective.
- Liaise with Corporate Finance, internal and external auditors during quarterly reviews and annual audit, as required.

What you bring
A finance analyst, with experience partnering with a wide range of functions and stakeholders around commercial deal activity
- Solid technical accounting skills with specific knowledge and application of current and future state revenue recognition guidance (ASC606)
- A coordinator of process and a trusted advisor experienced at solving problems with clear, constructive advice
- A clear thinker able to make decisions within intense time pressured scenarios
- Ability to network within a complicated, matrix organizational environment to promote the benefit and success of the Deal Hub and display superior collaboration skills

Added bonus if you have
- Experience within a similarly focused product and services organization, operating at a global enterprise level
- Interest in emerging innovation trends such as AI and technology to help build tools for the future of the function
- Proficiency in automation and AI-driven tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Copilot Studio etc.
